caption: The drawing shows three objects, each resembling a curved animal horn or powder horn, rendered in realistic detail with a focus on their shape and surface texture. The horns are tan and light brown in color, with shading that suggests a smooth, polished surface and some subtle variations in hue. The main horn in the center is the largest and curves prominently, fitted with a circular band around its thinner end and a rounded cap on its tip, while the wider end is open. Above and to the left is a similar, smaller horn, featuring a raised band near the narrow end and a cap at the tip; the wider part also remains open. At the bottom right, the third horn is oriented with its open end facing the viewer, prominently showing the inner curve and a slightly darker shading inside; it has a pair of small holes near the opening, and surface markings or engravings are faintly visible. The objects are set against an off-white, plain background with no additional context or scenery, and the shadows beneath each horn suggest depth and a grounded position on the page.
title: Hunting Horn
